skill.name: fix-my-opening-line
skill.description: Diagnose why a post's opening line is not stopping anyone, and rewrite it from several genuinely different angles. Use when someone says a post flopped, asks for a better hook, first line or opener, asks why nobody read something, or is stuck on how to start. Do not use it to write the whole post, and do not promise that a new opening will make a post perform.
skill.summary: Diagnose weak post openings and create honest, distinct hook options.
skill.author: prateeks367

content.value_statement: Weak opening lines can hide the strongest idea in an otherwise useful post. This skill diagnoses the opening and creates distinct, honest alternatives for comparison.
actual_capabilities: Diagnoses why an opening line fails to create interest.
Finds specific details in the post that could become the hook.
Creates at least three opening angles with different structures.
Explains the audience fit and risk of each proposed opening.
Preserves factual claims and avoids promises about performance.
limitations: It improves the opening only and does not write the entire post.
It cannot predict reach, engagement, or audience response.
It needs the post body to identify an accurate hook.
VoiceMOAT features require an eligible external connector plan.

use_cases.title: Recover a Buried Insight
use_cases.description: Find the most specific idea in a draft and move it into the opening without changing the post's meaning.

use_cases.title: Compare Hook Directions
use_cases.description: Generate contradiction, story, specific-detail, reframe, and confession options before choosing a final opening.

use_cases.title: Protect a Personal Voice
use_cases.description: Review whether a sharper opening still sounds like the writer and does not rely on exaggerated claims.

prompt_templates.title: Identify the Weakness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this opening as a stranger. Name its main weakness, quote the line, and explain what would make the next line necessary.

prompt_templates.title: Find the Hidden Hook
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the full post and identify the most specific sentence, detail, number, mistake, or moment that could lead the opening.

prompt_templates.title: Create Distinct Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Write five opening alternatives using contradiction, story, specific detail, reframe, and confession. Add the audience fit and risk for each.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Voice and Truth
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these opening options with the post. Recommend the strongest truthful option, explain its tradeoffs, and flag wording that does not sound like the writer.

output_examples.input: Opening: I want to share five lessons from launching my first product.
output: Diagnosis: The opening announces the topic before giving the reader a reason to continue.
Reframe: My first product taught me that shipping faster does not fix an unclear promise.
Risk: The claim invites disagreement, so it may attract debate.

output_examples.input: Draft detail: We spent three months building a feature that customers ignored.
output: Specific opening: We spent three months building a feature nobody asked for.
Story opening: Three months after launch, we learned customers had never wanted the feature.
Choice note: The specific version is clearer, while the story version creates more tension.

best_practices: Provide the full post when the strongest hook may be buried in later paragraphs.
Ask for different angles, not minor rewrites of the same sentence.
Choose an opening that the post can support with specific evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to guarantee reach, engagement, or virality.
Do not use a dramatic claim that the post cannot prove.
Do not treat a punchier opening as permission to replace the writer's voice.

faq.question: Does this skill rewrite the whole post?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on diagnosing and improving the opening line.

faq.question: How many alternatives does it create?
faq.answer: It creates at least three genuinely different angles when the draft supports them.

faq.question: Can it guarantee better performance?
faq.answer: No. Timing, audience, format, distribution, and luck also affect performance.

faq.question: Should I provide the full draft?
faq.answer: Yes. The full draft helps the skill find specific details without inventing claims.

faq.question: Can it preserve my writing style?
faq.answer: It can evaluate whether an option fits the supplied writing, but style matching is not guaranteed.

faq.question: What does the VoiceMOAT connection add?
faq.answer: An eligible connector can compare hooks with your voice profile and review your previous posts.
